paragraphs: I'm applying for the Finance & Analytics Analyst role with Cerberus Asset-Backed Opportunities. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The role caught my attention because it puts Excel modeling and AI tools side by side, which is how I like to work.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%. I also worked on AI-powered analytical dashboards, where I owned the mapping and QA, and they saved the team 4+ hours a week on reporting. At Thomson Reuters I managed cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of inflows and handled reconciliation with 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting.

That lines up with building models, keeping the numbers clean, and finding ways to cut manual work in recurring reporting. I'm careful with detail and comfortable juggling several workstreams at once. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the team.
